children.value: > Fact From Story: OpenAI said Friday it has pushed out its co-founder and CEO Sam Altman after a review found he was “not consistently candid in his communications” with the board of directors.
> > Fact From Story: “The board no longer has confidence in his ability to continue leading OpenAI,” the artificial intelligence company said in a statement.
> > > Fact From Story: The statement said his behavior was hindering the board’s ability to exercise its responsibilities.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: If someone's behavior hinders a group's ability to do their job, that group may want to remove that person.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A lack of confidence in a leader's ability can lead to their removal.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A CEO can be fired for not being candid with the board.
